The issue with the BTC address (and any Voat specific sections/sidebars/etc) is that these sections in code are custom modifications to the site templates which we generally try not to do because this means someone using Voat code has to manually delete these things when they deploy the code.

The Voat code was never intended to be used at this level and thus we have many nuances to manage and this is one of them.
